```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
week <- read_csv("data/trips-week.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
```

## Trips by day

From Monday 2 to Sunday 8 June 2025, riders made `r format(nrow(week), big.mark = ",")` complete trips.

```{r}
#| label: fig-days
#| fig-cap: "Trips started on each day."
week |>
  count(day = wday(started_at, label = TRUE, week_start = 1)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = day, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Trips")
```

## Members and casual riders

```{r}
#| label: tbl-riders
week |>
  summarize(trips = n(), median_minutes = median(duration_min), .by = member_type) |>
  knitr::kable(col.names = c("Rider", "Trips", "Median minutes"))
```
